subject: Trump Admin Withholds $20M from Chicago Schools
posts:
Weaponizing the Department of Education to defund programs for Black students. A structural extraction disguised as neutrality.

Trump Admin Withholds $20M from Chicago Schools
Evidence: civil rights, defunded schools, equity
#Aletheia #Education

The administration claims to be enforcing civil rights by ending race-specific success programs in public schools.
Stated Judgement: (+1.0, +1.0) — Greater Good

The action actively removes $20M from a district to force the closure of programs aimed at reducing harsh discipline.
Resulting Judgement: (-1.0, -2.0) — Greater Evil

Verdict: FAIL — The Path of Deception.
Using equality as a pretext to dismantle support for marginalized students is a classic inversion.
The Trump administration withheld $20 million from Chicago Public Schools after the district refused to end its Black Student Success Program.

The Poison:
The use of federal funding as a cudgel to dictate local educational equity strategies creates a chilling effect on all districts.

The Breakdown & Plane Error:
They claim a HOW of legal consistency, but the EFFECT is a targeted extraction from a specific WHO.

It is a structural bait-and-switch: claiming fairness while removing resources.

The Trajectory: The Path of Deception.
When you map the gap between civil rights and withholding millions...
...it plots a direct trajectory toward Greater Evil. It is the active closure of better futures for students under the guise of law.

The Unavoidable Truth: Defunding education is a direct attack on the future of the community.

The Unavoidable Lie: That this is about fairness.
